hooks.text: "The Guild wants to know how deep the Barrows go. Walk down until you'd rather not, then go one more."
"My regulars argue every night about how deep it goes. Settle it, so I can stop hearing about it."
"Before the Watch sends anyone down, it wants to know what it would be sending them into. So, you first."
"They say the Ember's light is stronger the deeper you go. Go and see whether they are right, and come back to tell us."
"I'll sell rope by the yard to whoever goes next. Tell me how many yards."
"Something down there hums. You can feel it through the axle. Find where it's coming from."

brief.one: Reach the {floor} floor of the Old Barrows
brief.many: Reach the {floor} floor of the Old Barrows

label: Floor reached in the Old Barrows
journal: Go down into the Old Barrows and take the stairs down, floor by floor, until you reach the {floor} floor.
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: You know how deep it goes. Deeper than that, probably.

hooks.text: "The Guild's map of {site} stops at the first floor. Go further and draw the rest, or at least come back and tell us."
"The lower rooms of {site} were sealed for a reason. We would like to know whether the reason is still down there."
"Lamp oil burns longer the deeper you go. That's not true, but buy some anyway, and go down into {site}."
"The water in {site} comes up from somewhere. Go down and find where, and whether it's eels."
"Wager on the board: nobody gets to the {floor} floor of {site} this month. Prove the house wrong."
"I took a party to {site} who said they'd go all the way down. Nobody paid the return fare. Go and collect."

fens.label: Floor reached in {site}
fens.journal: Go into {site} and get down to its {floor} floor.
fens.ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
fens.done: The Guild's map of the place got a little longer, and a little wetter.
